Unlocks the "[[THRUST Upper Receiver]]", "[[THRUST Lower Receiver]]" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.}} Note that this achievement can be completed by any number of players, as long as all ''human'' players are wielding saws as both primary and secondary weapons - it may therefore be best to bring AI henchmen to gun down the mobsters as rapidly as possible if going loud. The difficulty is not restricted, either, so the easiest difficulty can be chosen. [[Stockholm Syndrome]] basic combined with one of the saws lacking the Silent Motor will make it a little easier to complete the heist in stealth. To speedrun the heist in loud, one could complete it on [[Risk Level|Normal]], saw open the security door, use [[Trip mine (Payday 2)|Shaped Charges]] to open the safe and wait in the room for the pickup truck and escape van to arrive. Using melee will be easier to kill normal cops as specials enemies will be more absent on lower difficulties. {{Achievement|Hey Mr. DJ|jpg|In the [[Nightclub]] job, have {{color|value|12}} hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the [[Krinkov]] submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.
{{color|negative|'''''Note:''' Untied hostages will count toward this achievement if they are intimidated.''}}}} The achievement conditions consider intimidated civilians on the dance floor as hostages, thus it is not necessary to cable tie 12 civilians. {{Achievement|$1.8M Speedrun|jpg|In the [[Mallcrasher]] job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within {{color|value|50}} seconds of starting the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "[[Scope Mount]]" and "[[PBS Suppressor]]" for the AK weapon family, "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Alfred]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Dawn]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Dinosaur Skull]]" pattern.}} There are enough ATMs in the entrance area and lower shopping floors to complete this objective with saws or ECM jammers. With 2 or 3 teammates on Overkill difficulty(8 ATMs needed) and a bit of coordination, each picking a side and 1 assisting the other, they can easily complete the achievement. {{Achievement|Here Comes the Pain Train|jpg|In the [[Firestarter]] job, complete the heist on OVERKILL difficulty or above, with all days done in loud and with a crew of {{color|value|4}} players using unmodified "[[AK (Payday 2)|AK Rifle]]" rifles and "[[Para|PARA]]" submachine guns. Unlocks the "[[DMR Kit (AK)|DMR Kit AK.762]]" and the "[[Low Drag Magazine]]" for the AK weapon family, "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Timothy]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Prehistorical]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Dinosaur Stripes]]" pattern.}} Both weapons must be completely unmodified, and the primary weapon has to be ''specifically'' the '''AK Rifle'''.
In turn, both weapons must be freshly bought, since removing bolt-affecting modifications previously applied to it will not restore the default bolt. {{Achievement|The Turtle Always Wins|jpg|In the [[Art Gallery]] job, complete the heist in stealth within {{color|value|4}} minutes with each crew member wearing the [[Armor#Improved Combined Tactical Vest|Improved Combined Tactical Vest]] and no [[Armor Bag|Armor Kit]] deployable equipped. Unlocks the "[[Classic Stock]]" for the AK weapon family, "[[2 Piece Stock]]" for the AK and CAR weapon families, "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Pachy]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Fossil]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Prehistoric Predator]]" pattern.}} Note that 4 minutes is roughly the length of a four-player ECM chain. From level 68 onwards it is possible to build for the ICTV and all the ECM jamming upgrades. {{Achievement|Private Party|jpg|In the [[Jewelry Store|Jewelry store]] job, don't let the [[Enemies (Payday 2)|cops]] enter the jewelry store until the van comes back on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[DMR Kit (CAR)|DMR Kit AMR-16]]" and the "[[L5 Magazine]]" for the CAR weapon family, "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Vincent]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Feathers]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Butcher's AK/CAR Mod Pack DLC|Dinosaur Scars]]" pattern.}} This can be done numerous ways, but the least obvious method is to take the vantage point asset and snipe from across the street. The police AI will not send them into the building if there are no players or hostages inside and the front windows remain intact. As Twitch doesn't leave prior to going loud, Private Party can only be completed in open combat. This method is best done with 4 players. To keep the cops out of the Jewelry Store is to have 1 player at the back defending one of the offices. Another at the right office and two at the front covering the entrance. It may be beneficial to have two Technicians with [[Sentry Gun (Payday 2)|Sentry Guns]] and [[Trip Mine (Payday 2)|Trip Mines]], these can be used to cover the back windows and help the other duo at the front. One of the players at the front should have [[Inspire|Inspire Aced]] and the other player at the front be an [[Skills#Enforcer|Enforcer]] for maximum damage output. The randomly spawned container in the alley alley may benefit the crew in their attempt as the left-handed windows and office are completely blocked, meaning there will be one less entry/exit point to cover. Note that the police will not enter via the sides if the windows are intact and closed. Cloakers spawning inside the store via overhead vents will not void this achievement, though they may complicate the situation if the crew is caught off-guard. It is possible to solo this achievement holding the outside front of the store with a pair of sentries. Do not open or break any windows, and stay out front with the sentries. It is possible to solo this achievement from the vantage point. Sentries can be used to take out police units over the edges, letting you focus on keeping the front door clear. Do not bring AI henchmen as they will run into the store and draw in the police; they may also break windows. Shoot the first responders; frequently shoot further responders to hold their attention, and pay particular attention to any police straying towards the front of the store. Be careful not to shoot out the store front windows. The police will not break the windows, so the front door is their only entrance, and it's easy to cover from the vantage point. ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4ni8b0-armA Video]) Hold out until the van comes back; the heist doesn't need to be completed to get the achievement, and like the other achievements it can be done without DLC ownership. |-|Tips=
{{Achievement|Eco Round|jpg|In the [[GO Bank]] job, complete the heist without using your primary weapon on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
To unlock this achievement during a stealth run will be the most straightforward method as most players will normally use a high-concealment silenced secondary to neutralize patrolling guards and cameras. One should proceed with the heist as usual, without ever switching to their primary to avoid accidental discharges. Switching to a primary is not forbidden, but opening fire with one is.

As this is a solo achievement, the weapon status of other crewmates does not count against progression.

{{Achievement|Sewer Rats|jpg|In the [[GO Bank]] job, complete the heist having secured all bags of cash via the sewers on the OVERKILL difficulty or above}}
The sewer escape required for the achievement only triggers under certain circumstances, which are: all loot has been loaded stealthily, but the alarm sounds; if the loot cage has been lifted, regardless of if loot is inside; or if the pilot crashes the plane. Since the first disqualifies players (''i.e.'' all loot is required) it is best completed by deploying the balloon as soon as the cage is built, sending it with no bags inside. Note that the cage needs at least one bag in it to be able to raise the balloon, therefore remove the bag immediately after raising the balloon. Although this achievement can be done loud, players may wish to stealth up until the point all of the bags have been removed from the vault, then the alarm needs to be raised (either don't answer the phone when it rings or run through the vault lasers).

After the pickup is made, the correct manhole will be highlighted and players must move bags towards it. Due to the difficult escape conditions, it is highly recommended players move the bags into the sewers before entering; a player entering the manhole cover triggers the escape timer, so players should plan accordingly.

Players should preferably start moving at the very end of an assault to minimize resistance. Depending strongly on the map's spawns, players will have to move all the money bag spawns through a maze of varying length and difficulty, and may have to bypass a cage door. As players only have around three minutes to load the loot and escape, one player should consider running ahead with light armor to locate the escape.

In order to unlock the achievement, '''all the money loot bags must be secured to the van loot bag drop zone''' within the escape zone before the escape is initiated, because the bags carried with the players during the escape moment don't count towards this achievement. Special attention should be kept on the proper loot dropping due the very stressful situation when just few seconds are left to finish the heist while the players are dropping the last loot bags.

{{Achievement|We Are All Professionals|jpg|In the [[GO Bank]] job, complete the heist without the alarm going off and without killing any civilians on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
Acting as more of a chore than a challenge, this achievement requires a much more vigilant stealth approach than usual, and often means sacrificing a large amount of the loot to escape before a hostage calls the police. The achievement is significantly easier when attempted with basic [[Stockholm Syndrome]], aced [[ECM Specialist]], and an [[OVE9000]] saw with the Silent Motor equipped. Taking great care to case the bank for cameras and guards, players must ECM rush the bank with utmost precision, by killing guards, controlling civilians, and breaking cameras without smashing any windows or killing any innocents.

Answering any pagers and tying all civilians, players must swiftly move all hostages to the rear of the bank and out of sight. With the hostages moved and windows unbroken, civilians will only panic once they enter the bank and see it is empty; should they keep spawning and entering, a player with Stockholm Syndrome should routinely terrify any untied civilians. The bank's guards and investigating officers may drop additional cable ties, which can alleviate this or even remove the need for rigorous shouting.

Acquiring the cards and answering the phone, the heist thus continues as usual for stealth. When the GenSec and/or police arrive, they should enter the bank as normal provided no external broken cameras are visible. Regardless, players should take care killing them, doing so with tact and bagging the corpses immediately to prevent civilians seeing. Once the vault is open, boxes should be opened as fast as possible and, once a bag of loot is found, players should dash to the van before the alarm can be raised.
|-|Trivia=
* The teaser achievements are a reference to the nursery rhyme/{{w|Christmas carol}} {{w|Christmas is Coming}}.
* '''We Are All Professionals''' is a reference to the film ''{{w|Léon: The Professional}}'', where the main character, Léon, refuses to kill women and children in his line of work. The achievement icon is also a reference, showing Léon's trademark woolen hat and carrying his plant. Also, in ''Global Offensive'', the Terrorist faction in this map is called "Professional".
* '''Eco Round''' is a reference to a player term in the ''{{w|Counter Strike}}'' series, which [[GO Bank]] is based on. When players are low on in-game money, players will call out an "Eco Round" in which the team will resort to using their starting secondary weapons.
* '''Dead Presents''' is a pun on "Dead Presidents", as the portraits found on American bank notes are mainly of now-deceased former presidents.

Completing this achievement will unlock the Theia Magnified Scope for sniper rifles.}} ===Methods for completing the achievement=== The easiest way to get the achievement is to modify a sniper rifle with a laser sight and play a heist with a zip line on normal difficulty with no companions, be they other players or AI. Several heists have a zip line added if the [[Assets#Vantage Point|Vantage Point]] asset is purchased. As you do not need to complete a contract for achievement progress to register, if you die during the heist you can simply restart it and carry on until you have the requisite 10 kills. Nonetheless it may be wise to carry a medical bag or ammo bag with you. ====Bank Heist==== This is probably the easiest heist on which to get this achievement (except for the White Xmas Heist) The vantage point asset gives a zip line from the roof of the bank to the higher roof of a building across the street, and a second zip line in the reverse direction. If you find shooting enemies in the street to be difficult, they will eventually climb up to the two roofs where they will be easier to kill as you approach them. Note that the zip line from the higher roof to the lower is considerably faster than the opposite direction, and will give little time to make shots. ====Rats/Cook Off==== The Vantage Point asset gives a zip line from the starting point to the roof of the meth house. Several Mendoza hostiles will spawn outside the building. To return to the ground, you can jump from the roof to the balcony on the opposite side of the zip line and from there either go down the stairs or jump to the adjacent shed roof and from there to the ground. You can also jump from the roof of the house directly to the shed roof on the same side of the building as the zip line, and then from there to the ground. ====White Xmas==== The [[White Xmas]] Heist contains many zip lines and lots of enemy will spawn, making it extremely convenient to grind for kills on zip lines in this heist. However, the zip-lines' high speed may require some practice to be accustomed to. {{Achievement|Last Action Villain|jpg|Perform a headshot kill on [[Enemies (Payday 2)|enemies]] using only the [[R93]] sniper rifle while zip lining. Completing this achievement will unlock the Compensated Suppressor for the R93 sniper rifle.}} One of the easiest ways to get the achievement is to modify an R93 with a laser sight and play Rats on normal with no companions, be they other players or AI. Purchase the Vantage Point asset and you'll get a zipline leading up to the roof of the meth house. Several Mendoza hostiles will spawn outside the building. Properly specced, you can jump from the roof to the roof of the shed and then drop down to the ground if you miss on your first ride. As you do not need to complete a contract for achievement progress to register, you can simply restart the mission until you have the achievement. Another very easy way to get this achievement is to use a laser sight and play Bank Heist. Purchase the Vantage Point asset and use the two-way zipline to move across the street while shooting at enemies below you. Alternatively, wait for an enemy to climb the ladder from the alleyway to the vantage point, and shoot at his head when you approach the vantage point on the zipline. It is easier to use the zipline that goes from the bank roof to the vantage point for this achievement as it travels much slower. If you fail to kill an enemy with the headshot, simply take the other zipline back to the bank roof and try again. {{Achievement|You Can’t Hide|jpg|Kill {{color|value|25}} [[Enemies (Payday 2)|enemies]] shooting through walls or objects using only the [[R93]] sniper rifle. Completing this achievement will unlock the Wooden Body for the R93 sniper rifle.}} One could take advantage of the cars seen in numerous heists, such as in [[Hoxton Breakout]] Day 1, as you can generally see through them but they are thin enough that snipers can punch right through them. Another method for the achievement would be to use the advantage point on [[Rats]] day 3, as the railings on the tower count as wall but can be shot through and seen through. Finally, one could mark special enemies or guards and then run around to the other side of the nearest, thinnest wall/object. |-|Trivia= * '''Lord of the Flies''' is a reference to the novel of the {{w|Lord of the Flies|same name}}. * '''Far, Far Away''' achievement is a reference to the 1939 movie ''{{w|The Wizard of Oz (1939 film)|The Wonderful Wizard of Oz}}''. * '''Last Action Villain''' is a reference to the 1993 film ''{{w|Last Action Hero}}''. * '''Dodge This''' is a line from ''{{w|The Matrix}}'', which Trinity says just before killing an agile opponent with a headshot, similar to the achievement but with a [[Thanatos .50 cal]]. * '''Surprise Motherfucker''' is the catchphrase and one of the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fr2RqAd9GAM famous lines] of James Doakes, a character from the TV series ''{{w|Dexter (TV series)|Dexter}}''. * '''Build Me an Army Worthy of Crime.net''' is a reference to a quote in the film ''{{w|The Lord of the Rings (film series)|The Lord of the Rings}}''. * '''The Man with the Golden Gun''' is a reference to the {{w|James Bond}} {{w|The Man with the Golden Gun (novel)|novel}} and {{w|The Man with the Golden Gun (film)|film}} of the same name. ** The number of [[Bulldozer (Payday 2)#Skulldozer|Skulldozer]] kills required for the achievement references the number of people killed by the user of the Golden Gun, Francisco Scaramanga, in the novel and the film: 6. {{Achievement|Celsius or Fahrenheit?|png|Kill {{color|value|10}} enemies in a row, without missing, while switching between the regular sight and the [[Template:ComGad2|45 Degree Red Dot Sight]] after each kill on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
Completing the achievement requires the player to switch back and forth between the 45-degree sight and the regular aiming mode between each kill. As it does not have an additional time limit, this achievement can be taken slowly and carefully so that one does not miss. A few [[Concussion Grenade]]s can help.

If all else fails, try dominating an enemy and kill him when he's trying to surrender, then flip to the other sight mode. Rinse and repeat 9 more times to unlock the achievement.
{{Achievement|The Reconing|png|Complete any heist from start to end and kill {{color|value|200}} or more enemies with any weapon equipped with the [[:Template:ComSigAR|Reconnaissance Sight]] on the Very Hard difficulty or above.}}
Due to their practically endless nature, the [[White Xmas]] and [[Cook Off]] heists are the prime candidates for unlocking this achievement as enemies will spawn non-stop until the player(s) exit the map.

The Reconnaissance Sight itself does not need to be actually aimed through for the kills to register.
{{Achievement|Let Them Fly|png|Kill {{color|value|50}} [[Sniper (Payday 2)|Snipers]] with the [[Arbiter]] Grenade Launcher while using the standard ammo type.}}
Playing on enclosed heists like [[Hoxton Breakout]] Day 2, or ones with easily reachable Sniper perches such as the [[Safe House Raid]] can help make progress easier.

|-|Trivia=
*The achievements for the difficulty achievements are the first to be added before the update containing the achievements' content, as well as the first to have fewer teasers than released achievements.
*'''His Beard Was as White as Coke''' is a reference to the play ''{{w|Hamlet|The Tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark}}'' by {{w|William Shakespeare}}, specifically a line in [http://nfs.sparknotes.com/hamlet/page_250.html Act 4, Scene 5].
*''';)''' is an often used reply on the Steam forums by Overkill employee Almir, who portrays and voices the pilot in [[White Xmas]].
*'''Dance Dance GenSec''' may be a reference to either {{w|Dance, Dance (Fall Out Boy song)|the song by Fall Out Boy}}, {{w|Dance, Dance (Booty Luv song)|the song by Booty Luv}}, or the video game series ''{{w|Dance Dance Revolution}}''.
*'''I Know What I Like''' is from [[Art Gallery]]'s briefing screen.
*'''All About the Green''' is a reference to the song of the same name used in the musical ''{{w|The Wedding Singer (musical)|The Wedding Singer}}''.
*'''Gold Rush''' is a reference to the {{w|California Gold Rush}}.
*'''Fort Knoxed Down''' is a pun on "knocked down" and {{w|Fort Knox}}, in which is the {{w|United States Bullion Depository}}.
*'''Blood is Thicker Than Murkywater''' is a reference to the saying "{{w|blood is thicker than water}}".
*'''Mile High Club''' refers to the {{w|Mile high club|sexual slang}}.
*'''This is WAR Baby!''' is part of a quote from [[Jimmy]], who contracts the [[Boiling Point]] heist.
*'''What Are You Sinking About''' is a reference to a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yR0lWICH3rY German commercial about learning English].
*'''I Cut Down Trees, I Skip and Jump''' is a line from {{w|the Lumberjack Song}} by the {{w|Monty Python}} group.
*'''Long Gone''' may be a reference to [[#Spring Break Event|one of the achievements]] released with the [[Car Shop]] heist, which in turn references the film ''{{w|Gone in 60 Seconds (1974 film)|Gone in 60 Seconds}}'' and its {{w|Gone in 60 Seconds (2000 film)|2000 remake}}.
*'''In the Name of Heisenberg''' is a reference to the TV show ''{{w|Breaking Bad}}'' and its main protagonist {{w|Walter White (Breaking Bad)|Walter White}}, who goes by the alias "Heisenberg".
*'''Bag Throwing Simulator''' is a humorous nickname for ''[[PAYDAY 2]]''. On high difficulties, completion of the [[Diamond Store]] heist involves securing many loot bags.
*'''4 More Years''' references the duration a president stays in office in the United States once elected, "more" meaning being re-elected.
*'''Just Walk Straight Into The Bank''' is a quote from [[Bain]] in both the [[First World Bank|original First World Bank]] and the [[First World Bank (Payday 2)|remake]].
*'''First World Problems''' is a reference to a [http://knowyourmeme.com/memes/first-world-problems meme].
*'''What a Flat!''' is a quote from [[Bain]] in Day 3 of [[Framing Frame]].
*The achievements for completing [[GO Bank]] on the Mayhem and Death Sentence: One Down difficulties were originally named '''Rush B''' and '''I Would Like to Move My Money to a Bank That Doesn't Get Robbed''' respectively. The Death Sentence: One Down achievement was renamed and the old name moved to the Mayhem achievement in a later update, because there also was a [[Side Jobs# Potential Daily Safe House Challenges|Side Job]] called Rush B.
*'''I Would Like to Move My Money to a Bank That Doesn't Get Robbed''' is part of a phone call that can be heard in the [[GO Bank]] heist in stealth.
*'''The Global Elite''' is the highest rank in the [[w:c:counterstrike:Competitive|Competitive mode]] in ''{{w|Counter-Strike: Global Offensive}}''.

*'''Now is the Nuclear Winter of Our Discontent''' is a reference to the play ''{{w|Richard III (play)|Richard III}}'' by {{w|William Shakespeare}}, specifically its first line.

Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Cloaker-san]]" mask, "[[Materials#Hardcore Henry Heists|Rusty]]" material and "[[Patterns#Hardcore Henry Heists|Rebel]]" pattern.}} This achievement is very simple to complete, especially in multiplayer, as merely all that is required is for both bomb parts to be found and secured on any difficulty and then escape. {{Achievement|The Pacifist|jpg|Complete the [[Murky Station]] job without anyone in the crew killing anyone. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Augmentation]]" mask, "[[Materials#Hardcore Henry Heists|Spaceship]]" material and "[[Patterns#Hardcore Henry Heists|Squares]]" pattern.}} This is also simple, and in fact can be done alongside Ghost Run easily. The achievement only requires the crew to not get caught. If a guard has detected a player out in the open and both EMP parts have been found, at that point the players can ECM rush the remainder of the heist, provided their ECMs have enough upgrades. If one desires, one can dominate the entire basement (obviously out of sight of cameras on the [[Death Wish]] difficulty) to facilitate moving bags. These same tactics can also be applied to the [[Achievements (Payday 2)#Hotfix 97.4|Looting in the Dark]] achievement, with the obvious difference of having to secure all of the loot in the heist. {{Achievement|No Witnesses|jpg|Complete the [[Murky Station]] job by killing all guards and not using any [[ECM Jammer|ECM jammers]] on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}} This achievement is trickier, but still very doable. Note the following instructions work ''only'' on Overkill. There are 7 guards on the surface, and 3 guards in the basement. Shoot all of the cameras in the basement, then kill all of the guards in the basement. Then go up to the surface and find and secure the EMP bomb parts. How the heist is finished depends on the size of the player crew and where the escape vehicle is: #'''Van:''' In multiplayer, the crew will start from the docks side of the map and shoot through the trainyard to the van. In singleplayer, the player will have to snipe the remaining guards from the bridge overlooking the trainyard. The [[Lebensauger .308]] is recommended not only because of its fire rate, but also because it's easy to conceal. #'''Boat:''' In multiplayer, the crew will start from the side of the trainyard closest to the starting point and shoot through the trainyard. If playing in singleplayer, the player will be forced to restart because it's virtually impossible to kill all of the guards single-handedly and reach the escape zone before the escape timer runs out. This achievement can also be done on the [[Death Wish]] difficulty, but obviously more difficult due to the presence of Titan cameras. It also only can be done if the escape vehicle is the van. The crew will play out the heist normally up until the EMP parts are secured in the van. At that point, one or two players will go to the opposite end of the map, one player will go down to the basement, and, while not required but highly recommended, one player will snipe from the bridge. Once the drones turn on and return to a resting position (so the alarm doesn't go off earlier than desired), the crew member(s) near the docks will kick off the killing spree, running beneath the bridge to the escape point, the crew member on the bridge will snipe the guards the previous player(s) couldn't reach, and the last player will shoot up the basement. {{Achievement|They Don't Pay Us Enough|jpg|In the [[Meltdown]] job, complete the heist with all additional loot secured. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Meltdown|Rad Mutant]]" mask.}}
Attempting this on a lower difficulty is recommended due to the time-consuming nature of hunting all the loot and the extra crowbar spawns. Crews should attempt a co-ordinated and rigorous sweep of the entire map, with the priority on seeking crowbars and opening all the containers and warehouse cages. Care should be taken to ensure that bags aren't taken back by the cops - the best options are either to load them into a vehicle or to place them in the alleyway towards the escape, as cops will not leave the yard to collect them.

Multiple trips will be necessary in order to bring all the bags to the escape, the crew will have to decide how to proceed but clearly the Longfellow is the easiest vehicle to take on multiple trips. Choosing to eliminate the SWAT vans may be a wise move.

{{Achievement|There Was A Car?!|jpg|In the [[Meltdown]] job, complete the heist without using the "[[Vehicles#Longfellow|Longfellow]]".}}
First and foremost, attempting this on a lower difficulty is highly recommended, as the high concentration of enemies and snipers combined with having to move very heavy bags can make this difficult even on Normal. Further, players should equip themselves to deal with SWAT van turrets as it may be necessary to eliminate one or more along the way.

The heist can be completed as usual aside from avoiding the Longfellow, with players even using the forklifts as desired. Upon reaching the gate, there are two ways to progress: on foot, or by forklift. Players proceeding on foot have the comfort of moving as a unit and use of all four guns, along with freedom to place health and ammo bags. On the other hand, multiple forklifts can speed up the process significantly, leaving the drivers exposed but able to carry three loot bags on the forks and any other players on the back. A well co-ordinated team may even be able to drive the forklifts in reverse, allowing the passenger on the back to fire forwards.

Regardless of approach, players should take care moving along the paths, making sure to avoid the SWAT van if possible or simply eliminate it with high power weaponry. After finally reaching the train, players can end the heist as usual.

The "secret item" is a comically oversized bottle. It spawns in one of four locations: In the vantage point, the bar, the roof's supporting structure above the bar area, and in the bunker. Due to a possible spawn location being in the vantage point, players that want this achievement will require owning the [[Gage Sniper Pack]] DLC or have a friend that owns it, and since it can spawn in the bunker, which can not be opened unless the bike seat is required for the bike, multiple tries may be required to get it.

{{Achievement|Let the Man Work|jpg|In the first day of [[The Biker Heist]] job, let Mike the mechanic finish the bike without any interruptions on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Biker Heist DLC|The Classic]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Biker Heist DLC|Hotrod]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Biker Heist DLC|Engine]]" pattern.}}
The easiest way to accomplish this is to simply set a [[Sentry gun (Payday 2)|sentry gun]] on each side of the mechanic and replace them when they run out of ammo. To counter Maximum Force Responders and [[Shield (Payday 2)|Shields]], acing the [[Engineering]] skill and setting them to AP Rounds mode is recommended.

{{Achievement|Full Throttle|jpg|Complete the second day of [[The Biker Heist]] job within 120 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Biker Heist DLC|Speed Devil]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Biker Heist DLC|Devil Eye]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Biker Heist DLC|Skull Wing]]" pattern.}}
A crew of at least 2 human players is recommended, to get past welding objectives faster and to help up other crew members quickly. It is almost required for at least one of the crew to have [[Inspire]] aced to not only speed up the run to the front of the train, but also to swiftly help up downed crew members. Acing [[Close By]]/[[Lock N' Load]] is a good idea to deal with nuisance enemies while still keeping up the fast pace. Wearing armor heavier than the [[Armors#Heavy Ballistic Vest|Heavy Ballistic Vest]] is strongly recommended against.

The enemies that spawn can mostly be avoided, unless they are directly in the path towards a door. [[Sniper (Payday 2)|Snipers]] and [[SWAT Van Turret|turrets]] only pose significant threat when a crew member is downed or the crew needs to weld open a door, and can otherwise be ignored.

The Biker Boss at the front end of the train can only take up to 800 damage per shot, making the [[Thanatos .50 cal]] and [[HRL-7]] ''extremely'' ineffective at killing her. The best way to deal with her quickly is to pair a high damage-per-second weapon with aced [[Swan Song]], for example the [[Akimbo Krinkov]].

They were replaced on December 16, 2014.'' {{Teasers |Affliction |Curse |Bane |Plague |Blight |Corruption |Ouch }} |-|Tips= {{Achievement|Smoke and Mirrors|jpg|In [[the Diamond]] job, steal [[Loot#Loot Bag Values|the Diamond]] in under {{color|value|10}} minutes. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Diamond Heist DLC|Pazuzu]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Diamond Heist DLC|Diamond]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Diamond Heist DLC|Horus]]" pattern.}} This achievement is especially difficult as, even on a perfect speed run on Normal, the crew will be pressed for time; as such, it is highly recommended that everyone holds sprinting perks and/or picking bonuses. Additionally, both playing alone or with friends carry their own disadvantages: coordinating means the hacks and loud escape can be summoned immediately, but playing offline allows players to pause and memorize the maze path. Regardless of approach, security must be disabled quickly, meaning either: sprinting to security whilst breaking alarmed cases to promptly trigger the {{Color|value|200}} second hack objective; or swiftly navigating between white doors and floors to find four boxes in stealth. Once the lasers are off or the shutters raised, the crew will be down a few minutes, meaning the time-locks must be started promptly and watched vigilantly; since the locks take a minimum of {{Color|value|120}} seconds and have a long interact time, any additional delays can make or break the attempt. Once inside the Diamond room, players will have just a few minutes to bypass the tile puzzle and, once the Diamond is grabbed, secure it and escape; since alarms do not impact the achievement, players should strongly consider sprinting straight out the door rather than carefully crossing back. Players attempting stealth should consider using the Bag Man asset with the aced [[ECM Specialist]] to hurry through the final objectives, and those choosing loud ''must'' trigger the chopper immediately lest the {{Color|value|120}} second chopper response time ruin the run. To summarize, the restrictions on timers means that, between spawn and escape, stealth players need only give account for the time locks. However, loud attempts require {{Color|value|200}} seconds to hack security, {{Color|value|120}}/{{Color|value|150}} seconds for time locks, and then {{Color|value|120}} seconds for the chopper, meaning players only have 2 minutes 40 seconds (or 2 minutes 10 seconds on Overkill or Deathwish) to complete all other objectives and the tile puzzle. {{Achievement|Diamonds in the Rough|jpg|In [[the Diamond]] job, complete the heist, diamond puzzle and steal the Diamond after the alarm has been triggered on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#The Diamond Heist DLC|Anubis]]" mask, "[[Materials#The Diamond Heist DLC|Mummy Bandages]]" material and "[[Patterns#The Diamond Heist DLC|Hawk Helm]]" pattern.}} Despite the unclear description, the achievement is pretty straightforward: try and get as close to the diamond's vault door as you can, dealing with both timelocks if possible. If you make it that far without triggering the alarm, you won't have to hack the security PC to access the remainder of the objectives. At this point, get yourself detected (i.e. by throwing a grenade) and let security sound the alarm. Then complete the tile puzzle before the cops can arrive and signal the chopper to secure the diamond. It should be noted, however, that while easy enough given the time to work, players should be cautious of all enemy characters, who can set off the gas should they step on a tile; whilst friendly AI characters will not set off the trap, allies gained through the [[Joker]] skill ''will'' activate tiles, so take care if playing as a Mastermind. |-|Tips=
{{Achievement|Stalker|jpg|In the [[Breakin' Feds]] job, have [[Solomon Garrett|Commissioner Garret]] marked at all time after he left his office, until you have opened his safe.}}

The easier, and likely intended, approach is to have 1 or 2 players constantly marking Garrett either manually or with [[Sixth Sense]] while the safe is handled by the other player(s). If Garrett walks back inside the office before the safe is opened, safe locations to keep him marked with Sixth Sense are behind the printer in the kitchen (on the left side of the building) and behind the desk at the cubicle just outside his office (on the right side of the building).

A single-player alternative is to ace [[More Firepower]] and place [[Trip mine (Payday 2)|sensors]] in the locations where he will stand after he leaves his office, outside his door, and in the paths he walks, though this obviously requires extensive knowledge of the paths he takes, and also leaving a few trip mines to mark him in his office in case the safe isn't opened on the first attempt.

Regardless of the approach taken, all players involved acing [[High Value Target]] can help greatly with getting the achievement.

Note that if Garrett is lured out a fourth time with the food (either due to difficulty in acquiring/inputting the code or trying to get the '''A Moment of Silence''' achievement), the code to the safe will have to be punched in almost immediately, as Garrett despawns shortly after entering the restroom, and thus cannot be marked.

{{Achievement|Staple Relationship|jpg|In the [[Breakin' Feds]] job, find, rescue and return the stapler to the small office.}}

A red stapler has to be found and returned to the cluttered office near where Garrett's office can spawn in the left side of the building. The stapler counts as equipment, and can only be placed by, and the achievement awarded to, the player that picked up the stapler.

The stapler spawns in one of 14 locations, which are noted in [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1368968819 this guide].

Inside the lower control room is a notepad on the center table, which can be interacted with to reveal the code to the private office. As the crew escapes through the rig, a detour can be made to run back to the private office. The code can then be entered, allowing access to the office. Inside are four stacks of cash; two on a shelf and two in suitcases. The crew can either carry each bag down to the escape boat and secure them, or toss the bags out the window. |-|Trivia=
*The teasers are text taken from the {{w|Wikipedia}} article on {{w|bank robbery}}.
*Like the difficulty achievements released on Locke and Load Day 3, most of the names of the achievements released in this update are player suggestions from the [https://steamcommunity.com/app/218620/discussions/10/154645497345310070/ Do you know what would be a great name for an achievement?] thread.
*'''Just an' Old Country Doctor''' may be reference to the song "Just An Old Country Preacher" by {{w|Larry Sparks}}.
*'''Home is Where the Battle is''' refers to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z066RWjHqIc song of the same name] composed by {{w|Dasha Charusha}}, composed for the ''{{w|Hardcore Henry}}'' soundtrack.
*'''{{w|Megalodon}}''' is a species of {{w|shark}}. This was formerly the name of the achievement for completing [[the Yacht Heist]] on One Down.
*'''Hey, It Looks Like You are Robbing a Bank''' is a reference to the {{w|Office Assistant|Microsoft Office Assistant}}, better known as "Clippit/Clippy" by its paperclip avatar, infamous for being annoying. Some players have compared [[Bain]] nagging the players about the thermal drill to Clippy.
*'''Make Like a Tree...and Get Out of Here''' is one of {{w|Biff Tannen}}'s taglines in the {{w|Back to the Future (franchise)|''Back to the Future'' franchise}}.
*'''Bad Code''', '''Bank on Me''', and '''Lots of Pigs, But no Pigs''' are [[achievements]] from ''[[PAYDAY: The Heist]]''.
*'''Some People Want to See the World Burn''' refers to a [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/some-men-just-want-to-watch-the-world-burn memetic quote] from ''{{w|The Dark Knight}}''.
*'''Four Heister Discount''' is a reference to "five finger discount", another name for {{w|shoplifting}}. It may also be a reference to ''{{w|The Simpsons}}'', where a character calls shoplifting a "four finger discount", being a joke on the saying and most ''Simpsons'' characters only having four fingers on each hand.
*'''Hoxit''' is a pun on [[Hoxton]] and {{w|Brexit}}.
*'''The_heister27''' refers to a [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/thelegend27 meme] originating from an ad for ''{{w|Game of War: Fire Age}}''.
*'''Makin' My Way Downtown''' is a reference to {{w|Vanessa Carlton}}'s debut single "{{w|A Thousand Miles}}".
*'''Dead, Wrapped in Plastic''' refers to a quote from the {{w|Pilot (Twin Peaks)|pilot episode}} of ''{{w|Twin Peaks}}''.
*'''Fast Track to Hell''' may be a reference to punk rock musician [https://www.last.fm/music/Neon+Leon/+wiki Neon Leon's] autobiography of the same name.
*'''If It Bleeds, Kill It''' is likely a reference to a quote from ''{{w|Predator (film)|Predator}}''.
*'''Bain's Lament''' refers to "Baldwin's Lament", an entity that [[Bain]] was searching for.
*'''All You Need is A Knife''' may be a reference to the song "{{w|Ironic (song)|Ironic}}" by {{w|Alanis Morissette}}, which contains the verse ''"It's like ten thousand spoons when all you need is a knife"''.

*'''All the Gold in Chinatown''' The additional loot in the heist are:
**a tea set which is found in a safe in the back office of the auction room.
**6 artifacts (2 of which are paintings). In the room next to the auction room, there are 2 normal artifacts and 2 paintings. It is advised to bag all 4 artifacts in this room before turning on the lights as everyone will flood into the room. |-|Trivia=
*'''For The Mad Hatter''' is a reference to {{w|Hatter (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|The Mad Hatter}} from {{w|Lewis Carroll}}'s 1865 book {{w|Alice's Adventures in Wonderland}}, who is frozen in time forever stuck at 6pm in an endless tea party. The Hatter tried to sing to the foul-tempered {{w|Queen of Hearts (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|Queen of Hearts}} who sentenced him to death by decapitation. Father Time retaliated and froze The Mad Hatter in time out of respect for him. The "Laohu Dashi" outfit is a reference to {{w|Bruce Lee}} and his yellow jumpsuit. The name translates to "Tiger Master", referencing the black and yellow colors of the outfit.

The achievement requires access to the archaeology lab, so this may take several restarts.

After taking the Box out of the Ark, three buttons can be pressed on the sides of the chest. Pushing the middle, right, and left buttons in that order will reveal "something weird" and unlock the achievement shortly after.

{{Achievement|The Red Button|jpg|In the [[Henry's Rock]] job, push the red button and escape.}}
This achievement can only be done on the OVERKILL difficulty and above.

There is a button near the main terminal that will close once the terminal is hacked. Press it before hacking the terminal, and two [[SWAT Turret]]s (3 on Mayhem+) will spawn and [[Environmental hazards#Tear gas|tear gas]] will be pumped into the room. Once dealt with, play the heist as normal, and the achievement should be unlocked upon escaping.

{{Achievement|Press [F] to Pay Respects||Press [F] to pay respects.|image=Press F to Pay Respects.jpg}}

In one of the auction rooms in the heist, there is a display case containing Lindenhurst's mummified corpse. Either open it with the glass cutter or by smashing it open, then interact with the corpse to obtain the achievement.

{{Achievement|Heavy Metal|jpg|In the [[Shacklethorne Auction|Shacklethorne]] heist, use the metal detectors to find a [[Civilians|civilian]] that is carring{{sic}} something heavy. Unlocks the [[Monkey Wrench]] weapon.}}

There is a blue-outfitted civilian in the storage area that must be tied down and escorted to go through the metal detectors at the estate entrance. The metal detectors must be on, meaning they haven't been disabled manually and the alarm hasn't gone off. The metal detectors can be maneuvered around by jumping on and off the tables next to them.

The amount of cameras in the estate require either killing the camera operator or liberal usage of [[ECM Jammer]]s/[[Pocket ECM]]s.

It is recommended to attempt this on the Normal difficulty, as there will only be the camera operator, the guards patrolling the upper floor, the guard watching the metal detectors, one guard patrolling the ground floor (who can be easily avoided), and one guard looking out into the courtyard (who will likely not notice the civilian).

|-|Trivia=
*Most of the names of the achievements are player suggestions from the [https://steamcommunity.com/app/218620/discussions/10/154645497345310070/ Do you know what would be a great name for an achievement?] thread.
*'''Hello To You, My New Friends''' is a quote from [[Vernon Locke|Locke]] in [[Beneath the Mountain]], stated when the players zipline up the elevator shaft and meet Locke in person.
*'''Locke & Load''' is a pun on the phrase "lock and load" and Locke, as well as being the name of the Beneath the Mountain heist's default soundtrack and the name of the community event the achievement was released in.
*'''Drain the Swamp''' is a {{w|Drain the swamp|phrase}} used by American politicians, alluding to the historical draining of swamps to keep {{w|mosquito}} populations low to combat {{w|malaria}}. The phrase being attributed to Locke may indicate it is a reference to {{w|Jessica Stern}} who, in the article "Preparing for a War on Terrorism", calls on the U.S. to use foreign aid and soft power to combat ("drain") terrorism in failing/failed polities ("the swamps").
*'''FUBAR''' is military slang for "fucked up beyond all recognition/any repair".
*'''By Air, Land, and Sea''' refers to a quote from {{w|Winston Churchill}}, from the end of his "{{w|We shall fight on the beaches}}" speech.
*'''Madman Absolution''' is a reference to ''{{w|Hitman: Absolution}}''.
*'''Best Use of a Farm Animal''' was a category of the [https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards/2016/ 2016 Steam Awards].
*'''Golf Oscar Alpha Tango Sierra''' is "goats" in the {{w|NATO phonetic alphabet}}.
*'''All I Want for Christmas is You''' is a reference to "{{w|All I Want for Christmas Is You}}" by {{w|Mariah Carey}}.
*'''How the Winch Stole Christmas''' is a pun on ''{{w|How the Grinch Stole Christmas!}}'' and "winch", which the players use in the heist to airlift the Christmas tree and escape.
*'''The Princess is in Another Safe!''' is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/but-our-princess-is-in-another-castle But Our Princess is in Another Castle] meme that originated from ''{{w|Super Mario Bros.}}''
*'''Play Rough''' is from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a_z4IuxAqpE speech] in the final scene of ''{{w|Scarface (1983 film)|Scarface}}''.
*'''The World is Yours''' is the tagline of the {{w|Scarface: The World Is Yours|''Scarface'' video game}}.
*'''Reminds Me of Myself Back in the Day!''' is a quote from [[Bain]] played when the crew survives an [[Assault Waves|assault wave]].
*'''A Bridge Too Far!''' is an [[Achievements|achievement]] from ''[[PAYDAY: The Heist]]''.
*'''Washington City Marathon''' is not an accurate title, as [[Heat Street (Payday 2)|Heat Street]] takes place in {{w|New York City}}, rather than {{w|Washington D.C.}} as most of the rest of the heists in the game do.
*'''Keep Calm and Carry On... Shooting''' is a reference to the {{w|Keep Calm and Carry On}} British {{w|motivational poster}} made in preparation of {{w|World War II}}, which saw [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/keep-calm-and-carry-on a revival] 70 years later.
*Most of [[Charon|the Continental]] achievements are quotes from the ''{{w|John Wick}}'' film.
**'''Baba Yaga''' is what the Russian mafia Wick fights throughout the film codenames him.
*'''The Big Bank Theory''' is a pun on the {{w|Big Bang|Big Bang theory}}.
*'''Dead Man's Hand''' is a {{w|Dead man's hand|poker hand}} that is said to have been held by {{w|Wild Bill Hickok}} when he was murdered. It is also the name of the soundtrack for the heist.
*'''Prankcall''' is the [[w:c:hotlinemiami:Prank Call|name of a level]] in ''{{w|Hotline Miami}}''.
*'''Running in the 80's''' is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/max-coveri-running-in-the-90s memetic song] "Running in the 90's" made by {{w|Maurizio De Jorio}} under the alias of Max Coveri.
*'''Diesel is My Juice''' may be a reference to ''PAYDAY 2'' running on the {{w|Diesel (game engine)|Diesel engine}}.
*'''Sons of Robbery''' is a reference to ''{{w|Sons of Anarchy}}'', in which [[Rust]]'s actor, {{w|Ron Perlman}}, played as {{w|Clay Morrow}}.
*'''And Now for Something Completely Different''' is a reference to ''{{w|Monty Python's Flying Circus}}'', which would often use the line to open sketches, and is also the title of the {{w|And Now for Something Completely Different|1971 film}} that contained sketches from the first two seasons of ''Flying Circus'', intended for American audiences that had not seen the series.
*'''Itsy Bitsy Heisters Cooking Meth All Night Long''' is a reference to the {{w|Itsy Bitsy Spider}} nursery rhyme.
*'''Bain, I Shrunk the Heisters''' is a reference to ''{{w|Honey, I Shrunk the Kids}}''. A similar play on words was used as the tagline for the [[Lab Rats]] heist when it was released.
*'''Jailhouse Rock''' refers to either {{w|Jailhouse Rock (song)|the song of the same name}} by {{w|Elvis Presley}} and/or the {{w|Jailhouse Rock (film)|musical drama film}} for which the song was composed.
*'''¡La Victoria es Nuestra!''' is Spanish for "victory is ours".
*'''Plata o Plomo''' is a Colombian Spanish slang phrase that translates to "silver (money) or lead (bullets)", meaning "accept the bribe or lose your life".
*'''Hector's Heroes''' may be a reference to the American TV sitcom ''{{w|Hogan's Heroes}}''.
*'''Cooking for Dummies''' and '''Bank Robbery for Dummies''' are references to the ''{{w|For Dummies}}'' books.
*'''Alright Boys n Girls''' and '''This is Fucking War Baby!''' are quotes from [[Jimmy]].
*'''All Your Bass Are Belong To Us''' is a reference to a {{w|All your base are belong to us|meme}} that originated from ''{{w|Zero Wing}}''.
*'''Eat, Sleep, Heist, Repeat''' is likely a reference to the song "{{w|Eat, Sleep, Rave, Repeat}}" by {{w|Fatboy Slim}}.
*'''Forte to Fortissimo''' are {{w|Dynamics (music)|music dynamics terms}} meaning "loud" and "very loud".
*'''Veni, Saw, Vici''' is wordplay with the phrase ''{{w|Veni, vidi, vici}}'', which means "I came, ''I saw,'' I conquered".
*'''A Diamond Dozen''' is a pun on "a dime a dozen".
*'''Go, Go, Go''', '''pd_bank''', and '''Clutch''' are all references to ''{{w|Counter-Strike}}''.
*'''Making My Way Downtown''' is a reference to {{w|Vanessa Carlton}}'s debut single "{{w|A Thousand Miles}}".
*'''Heisty McHeistface''' is a reference to ''{{w|Boaty McBoatface}}''.
*'''The Little Heister That Could''' is a reference to ''{{w|The Little Engine That Could}}''.
*'''Modern Train Robbers''' was the name of the removed achievement for completing [[Transport: Train Heist|Train Heist]] on Death Wish.

To complete this achievement, the player must find three objects hidden around the map, and combine them at the anvil in Barn C.
==='''Hammer'''===
The hammer can be found in three possible locations:
<gallery>
hammer_1.png|On the second floor of Barn B, next to the turret overlooking the shooting range.
hammer_2.png|On the ground next to the anvil, in Barn C.
hammer_3.png|On a table near the radio at the back of the patio.
</gallery>
==='''Star Mould'''===
The mould can be found in three possible locations. It can be very hard to spot due to its small size.
<gallery>
mould_1.png|On the second floor of Barn B, near the turret overlooking the courtyard.
mould_2.png|On the second floor of Barn B, near the turret overlooking the left side of the barn.
mould_3.png|On a barrel next to a shack, near the kitchen side of the ranch house.
</gallery>
==='''Silver Bar'''===
To find the silver bar stash, the player must first acquire a crowbar. Once obtained, the player can interact with the wall located under the stairs on the right side of Barn B. Doing so will break the wall and reveal a box full of silver bars.
<gallery>
Silver wall.png| The exposed box of silver, after breaking open the wall.
</gallery>
</br>
Once all three items are obtained, the player must place all three items on the anvil located in Barn C. Doing so will create a sheriff's badge, and award the achievement once picked up.

|-|Trivia=
*'''For The Mad Hatter''' is a reference to {{w|Hatter (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|The Mad Hatter}} from {{w|Lewis Carroll}}'s 1865 book {{w|Alice's Adventures in Wonderland}}, who is frozen in time forever stuck at 6pm in an endless tea party. The Hatter tried to sing to the foul-tempered {{w|Queen of Hearts (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|Queen of Hearts}} who sentenced him to death by decapitation. Father Time retaliated and froze The Mad Hatter in time out of respect for him. The "Laohu Dashi" outfit is a reference to {{w|Bruce Lee}} and his yellow jumpsuit. The name translates to "Tiger Master", referencing the black and yellow colors of the outfit.
*The teaser achievements reference {{w|Sputnik 1}}, the world's first artificial satellite, made by the Russians in 1957. Vlad has been referred to as Sputnik multiple times. Sputnik 1 transmitted signals for 21 days before the transmitter batteries died, then 2 months later it burned up while reentering Earth's atmosphere. It had a diameter of 58cm, traveled at 8 km/s and had a cumulative distance traveled of 70,000,000 km.

''{{color|negative|Replaces the '''Secret Achievement'''.}}''}} |-|Teaser= |-|Trivia= *'''Big Brother''' is the synonym for abuse of government power, particularly in respect to civil liberties, often specifically related to mass surveillance. ** The term itself originated from {{W|George Orwell|George Orwell's}} 1949 novel ''{{W|Nineteen Eighty-Four}}'', where Big Brother is the supreme figurehead of Oceania, a totalitarian state wherein the ruling party Ingsoc wields total power "for its own sake" over the inhabitants, giving rise to the phrase ''"Big Brother is watching you"''. Generally, the idea conveys a line of propaganda, meaning citizens have to follow what a dictatorial government wants them to do, and if they do not, Big Brother will know, as it spies on them all the time.
